results.title: Invite a friend by email
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, Add a friend with an email address reads Send invitation; sending opens ONE small Home window, pointed at 'Be friends when they accept?' for that invitation (closed unanswered here; IN4 says yes), and says 'Invitation sent to …'; Sent requests shows the address as Invited by email with Resend and Cancel; Resend says it was sent again; Cancel takes it off. (The invitation calls are answered by the test, so no email goes out; each carries the reader's sign-in)
